verdict.rationale: The docs describe pushing existing data from a primary database or CSV/JSON files into Typesense, and the Cloud MCP server lets an agent "index your data". Both imply bulk ingestion, but the pack never explicitly documents a batch import, bulk update or bulk delete operation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk import/upsert endpoints, bulk update and delete-by-filter operations, batch sizing and error-handling details, and hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.
